name: Residential Solar Lease or Power Purchase Agreement
description: A long-term contract under which a company installs and owns solar panels on a home and the homeowner pays for the power or leases the system. The checks read for the three-business-day cancellation terms that apply to a contract signed at home, a confession of judgment or cancellation waiver, the annual price increase, the length of the term, a production guarantee, what happens when the home is sold, and filings against the property.
compliance_matrix_columns: Statement of the right to cancel within three business days
Confession of judgment, or waiver of the right to cancel
Whether the price rises, and by how much each year
What happens when the home is sold
